request: Build a reaction-time game in this empty project. The player waits for a signal: two seconds of game time (120 fixed ticks) after the game starts, a counter named `ready` goes from 0 to 1 and the screen says `Go!`. Pressing an input action named `react` (the space bar) before that is a false start: it adds 1 to a counter named `false_starts` and the two-second wait starts again from that press. The first `react` press after `Go!` sets a counter named `reaction_ms` to the milliseconds of game time since `Go!` appeared and shows that time on screen; presses after that change nothing. All three counters start at 0.
